'''2012 Bespin Regionals Matt Hanson DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Hanson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
